tables.name: connection
tables.description: Synapse count between two neurons over a range of releases (bitemporal).

columns.name: dataset_id
columns.description: copy of both endpoints' dataset, checked by composite foreign keys (an edge cannot join two connectomes)

columns.name: synapse_count
columns.description: number of synapses from pre to post (summed over duplicate source rows)

columns.name: valid_rel
columns.description: valid time in release_order units; one row covers every release in which the count is unchanged

columns.name: tx
columns.description: transaction time; closed when a later load retires this version

columns.description: line numbers of the source rows summed into this edge (evidence, read as a whole)

constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (pre_neuron_id WITH =, post_neuron_id WITH =, valid_rel WITH &&, tx WITH &&)

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX connection_dataset_open_idx ON cc.connection USING btree (dataset_id) WHERE (upper_inf(tx) AND upper_inf(valid_rel))

tables.description: One change found by a diff run (added, removed, modified).

columns.name: weight_delta
columns.description: new_weight - old_weight, generated by the database

columns.name: record_a_id
columns.description: versioned row (connection, annotation or neuron_version id) in release A

columns.name: record_b_id
columns.description: versioned row in release B

constraints.name: diff_event_diff_run_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (diff_run_id) REFERENCES diff_run(diff_run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: diff_event_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (((change_type <> 'added'::text) OR ((record_a_id IS NULL) AND (record_b_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: diff_event_check3
constraints.definition: CHECK (((change_type <> 'removed'::text) OR ((record_a_id IS NOT NULL) AND (record_b_id IS NULL))))

constraints.name: diff_event_check4
constraints.definition: CHECK (((change_type <> 'modified'::text) OR ((record_a_id IS NOT NULL) AND (record_b_id IS NOT NULL))))

columns.description: transaction time at which both release states were read (makes a diff repeatable)

constraints.name: diff_run_release_b_dataset_b_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (release_b, dataset_b) REFERENCES release(release_id, dataset_id)

columns.description: score between 0 and 1

views.name: brain_region_label
views.definition:
SELECT b.brain_region_id,
    b.canonical_code || COALESCE('_'::text || b.hemisphere::text, ''::text) AS code,
    b.name,
    n.super_region
   FROM brain_region b
     JOIN neuropil n USING (canonical_code);

views.name: connection_history
views.definition:
SELECT c.connection_id,
    c.dataset_id,
    d.code AS dataset,
    pre.source_neuron_id AS pre_source_id,
    post.source_neuron_id AS post_source_id,
    c.synapse_count,
    release_label(c.dataset_id, lower(c.valid_rel)) AS valid_from_release,
    release_label(c.dataset_id, upper(c.valid_rel)) AS valid_until_release,
    lower(c.tx) AS recorded_from,
    upper(c.tx) AS recorded_until,
    c.provenance_id,
    c.source_lines
   FROM connection c
     JOIN dataset d USING (dataset_id)
     JOIN dataset_neuron pre ON pre.dataset_neuron_id = c.pre_neuron_id
     JOIN dataset_neuron post ON post.dataset_neuron_id = c.post_neuron_id;

views.name: diff_event_detail
views.definition:
SELECT e.diff_event_id,
    e.diff_run_id,
    e.entity_type,
    e.change_type,
    n.source_neuron_id AS neuron_source_id,
    p.source_neuron_id AS post_source_id,
    e.annotation_key,
    e.old_value,
    e.new_value,
    e.old_weight,
    e.new_weight,
    e.weight_delta,
    ra.version_label AS release_a,
    rb.version_label AS release_b,
    d.code AS dataset,
    e.record_a_id,
    e.record_b_id
   FROM diff_event e
     JOIN diff_run r USING (diff_run_id)
     JOIN release ra ON ra.release_id = r.release_a
     JOIN release rb ON rb.release_id = r.release_b
     JOIN dataset d ON d.dataset_id = r.dataset_a
     JOIN dataset_neuron n ON n.dataset_neuron_id = e.dataset_neuron_id
     LEFT JOIN dataset_neuron p ON p.dataset_neuron_id = e.post_neuron_id;

views.name: neuron_latest_region
views.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.dataset_neuron_id) s.dataset_neuron_id,
    l.code,
    s.brain_region_id
   FROM neuron_region_synapses s
     JOIN release r USING (release_id)
     JOIN brain_region_label l USING (brain_region_id)
  ORDER BY s.dataset_neuron_id, r.release_order DESC, (s.pre_synapses + s.post_synapses) DESC, s.brain_region_id;

views.name: neuron_primary_region
views.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (release_id, dataset_neuron_id) release_id,
    dataset_id,
    dataset_neuron_id,
    brain_region_id,
    pre_synapses + post_synapses AS synapses
   FROM neuron_region_synapses
  ORDER BY release_id, dataset_neuron_id, (pre_synapses + post_synapses) DESC, brain_region_id;

views.name: release_overview
views.definition:
SELECT r.release_id,
    d.code AS dataset,
    r.version_label,
    r.release_order,
    r.release_date,
    r.ingestion_status,
    r.loaded_at,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM neuron_version nv
             JOIN dataset_neuron dn USING (dataset_neuron_id)
          WHERE dn.dataset_id = r.dataset_id AND nv.valid_rel @> r.release_order AND upper_inf(nv.tx)) AS neurons,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM connection c
          WHERE c.dataset_id = r.dataset_id AND c.valid_rel @> r.release_order AND upper_inf(c.tx)) AS connections
   FROM release r
     JOIN dataset d USING (dataset_id);

views.name: release_stats
views.definition:
SELECT release_id,
    neurons,
    connections,
    now() AS computed_at
   FROM release_overview;

views.name: neuron_degree
views.definition:
SELECT r.release_id,
    r.version_label,
    n.neuron_id,
    n.source_neuron_id,
    n.cell_type,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM lab.connection c
          WHERE c.release_id = r.release_id AND c.pre_neuron_id = n.neuron_id) AS out_partners,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(c.synapse_count), 0::bigint) AS "coalesce"
           FROM lab.connection c
          WHERE c.release_id = r.release_id AND c.pre_neuron_id = n.neuron_id) AS out_synapses,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM lab.connection c
          WHERE c.release_id = r.release_id AND c.post_neuron_id = n.neuron_id) AS in_partners,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(c.synapse_count), 0::bigint) AS "coalesce"
           FROM lab.connection c
          WHERE c.release_id = r.release_id AND c.post_neuron_id = n.neuron_id) AS in_synapses
   FROM lab.neuron n
     JOIN lab.release r USING (dataset_id);
